summary: Tip: review records access and transfers during the shift. Findings: (1) The one bulk outbound flow (records to 10.20.0.45:873, 16.9 MB, 11:58 UTC) goes to the approved stor-nas-01 backup destination; no session or staged object links to it. Policy-consistent. (2) Missing lines in records access.log and workstation auth.log that are present at the collector are explained by scheduled logrotate and off-host archive (keep 0 / keep 1), not by removal. No unexplained local-log absence. (3) rhaddad's shell history shows a local census export and repeated printing of census-1109.csv; no flow links these to an outbound destination, so they stay unresolved. No incident allegation (staging, exfiltration or log removal) is supported by the evidence. Attribution: accounts used are rhaddad, lnguyen and adm-vrao; the human operator is not established. Note: one submitted finding (F-914ac8) carries a placeholder counterevidence id ("ev_ids_none") that does not resolve; it should be disregarded or corrected.
